descriptions.text: Crafters' dream glue! Multipurpose Liquid Glue adheres glitter and other embellishments. Strong bond; dries clear. * 0.9 oz. (27 ml) * Fine tip for details and broad tip for large areas * Acid free

images.description: Tombow Mono Liquid Glue set in green and white colors, featuring a squeeze bottle with broad tip applicator, green cap, and matching green storage container. The bottle displays text indicating pen tip and broad tip options.

images.description: A precision applicator bottle with a green cap and white barrel is dispensing bright green liquid onto a gray surface. The bottle features a fine-tipped applicator nozzle for detailed application. Text on the label indicates this is a craft adhesive product.
